**Add `module.ttl` to `slices/profile/agent-runtime` or exclude manifest-only slices from ratchet discovery.**

`slices/profile/agent-runtime` contains `manifest.ttl` but no `module.ttl`. `discover_slice_dirs` selects it, and `ratchet_surface_paths` returns an error when the required module file is missing. The repository and base-tree residue measurements propagate this error, so the affected quality commands can fail for the whole repository.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Suggested fix</summary>

Add the required `module.ttl` to `slices/profile/agent-runtime`, or limit the new module-file requirement to the installed `projection-debt` entry point.

</details>
